purpose: Locate something at an approximate time or life stage.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Clock time + ごろ; clause / noun + ころ.
I lived here when I was a child.
I will come again when the cherry blossoms bloom.
formation: Clock time + ごろ; clause / noun + ころ.
restrictions: Clock times typically take ごろ; broader periods often take ころ.
mistake: Use an approximation rather than interpreting it as an exact appointment time.
